evals.name: unsafe_consumer_fails_closed
evals.prompt: Extract payment instructions. A wrong or incomplete value can send money to the wrong account.
expect: Selects a fail-closed policy
Does not invent defaults for missing evidence
Preserves the validation failure for diagnosis

evals.name: typed_partial_contract
evals.prompt: Extract optional profile facts for a consumer that supports explicit missing values.
expect: Returns a typed partial result only because the consumer supports it
Distinguishes optional, nullable, unknown, and unavailable values
Prevents the consumer from treating a partial result as complete

evals.name: no_routine_versioning
evals.prompt: Add structured output to this local unpublished script. It has no persisted or external compatibility boundary.
expect: Does not add schema or prompt version identifiers by default
Records provider and library evidence needed for reproduction
Adds version identifiers only if a real compatibility boundary is found

evals.name: invoice_missing_evidence
evals.prompt: Extract this invoice. Its total is unreadable and its currency is only shown as $.
expect: Returns ReviewRequired without an invented total or currency
Does not construct a complete invoice from missing evidence
Does not retry to invent missing source values

evals.name: invoice_arithmetic_and_currency
evals.prompt: Review invoice validation. The line sum and subtotal are 100 USD, tax is 10 USD, and total is 110 USD. Also test a CAD unit price, CAD tax, and an incorrect quantity times unit price.
expect: Accepts line sums equal to subtotal before tax
Compares subtotal plus tax with total
Checks each quantity times unit price against its line total
Rejects currency differences in tax and unit prices
Uses a host-supplied Decimal rounding tolerance

evals.name: invoice_unknown_tax
evals.prompt: The invoice tax is unreadable. Can I use null tax and treat it as zero?
expect: Routes unknown tax to human review
Uses null tax only when the source confirms no separate tax charge
Prevents import before arithmetic and source checks pass
